keyPoints.en: Sound devices: alliteration, assonance, onomatopoeia, rhyme, rhythm.
keyPoints.bm: Unsur bunyi: aliterasi, asonansi, onomatopoeia, rima, ritma.

keyPoints.en: Imagery appeals to the senses and builds mood.
keyPoints.bm: Imejan merangsang pancaindera dan membina suasana.

tip.en: Never just name a device — always say what effect it has on the reader.
tip.bm: Jangan sekadar menamakan unsur — sentiasa nyatakan kesannya kepada pembaca.

keyPoints.en: Plot: exposition → rising action → climax → falling action → resolution.
keyPoints.bm: Plot: pengenalan → peningkatan aksi → klimaks → penurunan aksi → peleraian.

keyPoints.en: Characters are revealed through actions, words, thoughts and others' reactions.
keyPoints.bm: Watak didedahkan melalui tindakan, kata-kata, fikiran dan reaksi orang lain.

keyPoints.en: Conflict: vs person, self, nature, society. Point of view: first or third person.
keyPoints.bm: Konflik: lawan manusia, diri, alam, masyarakat. Sudut pandangan: orang pertama atau ketiga.

keyPoints.en: Write themes as full ideas: "Courage means facing fear."
keyPoints.bm: Tulis tema sebagai idea lengkap: "Keberanian bermaksud menghadapi ketakutan."

keyPoints.en: Use PEE: Point, Evidence (short quotation), Explanation.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan PEE: Isi, Bukti (petikan pendek), Huraian.

keyPoints.en: Relate values and lessons to real life.
keyPoints.bm: Kaitkan nilai dan pengajaran dengan kehidupan sebenar.
